verdict.rationale: Quoted guidance text was extracted from sos.wa.gov's corporations-charities and home pages and from dor.wa.gov's business-license page, which implies the public reading surface serves readable HTML with no bot wall or CAPTCHA. The only JS-only shell observed was the authenticated My DOR tax portal (secure.dor.wa.gov). That is a transactional surface run by a different agency, not the published guidance. Missing for 10: a direct probe of sos.wa.gov guidance pages recording HTTP status and user agent, explicit confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot challenge appears, and independent corroboration of keyless agent access.
